# test_acf_bootstrap {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
test_acf_bootstrap(data, n_boot, h; alpha=0.05, block_size=1)
```
Compute a bootstrap hypothesis test for the classical autocorrelation at lag `h` and return an [`ACFTestResultBoot`](ACFTestResultBoot.qmd) with the bootstrap critical value, p-value, and reject decision.
 
Unlike [`test_acf()`](test_acf.qmd), this does not rely on the asymptotic N(0, 1/n) distribution and is therefore more reliable for short time series or non-Gaussian data.
 
  * `data`: the time series.
  * `n_boot`: number of bootstrap replications.
  * `h`: lag.
  * `alpha`: significance level (default `0.05`).
  * `block_size`: set `> 1` for a block bootstrap that preserves serial dependencies.


:::
